Biowasm and Aioli
=================
The Aioli runner (aioli.js), the base module (base/) and the WebAssembly builds
in this folder – all except GNU diffutils (diff, cmp) and the GNU grep 3.11 that
carries out "grep -P", which were compiled for the practical "AI agents for
bioinformatics", whose terminal this practical shares – come from the Biowasm project
(https://biowasm.com, https://github.com/biowasm/biowasm and
https://github.com/biowasm/aioli). The licence below is that of Biowasm and
Aioli themselves. It does not relicense the programs: each program keeps its
own licence, which is in its folder (NAME/VERSION/) together with a NOTICE.txt.
(The folder of the base module, base/1.0.0/, has a notice and checksums only:
its licence is the one below.)
Local changes are listed in RUNTIME-PATCHES.txt.

Comlink
=======
aioli.js includes Comlink (https://github.com/GoogleChromeLabs/comlink), the
library that carries the calls between the page and the worker in which the
programs run. Its source files state:

    Copyright 2019 Google LLC
    SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

The text of the Apache License, Version 2.0 is in ../licenses/Apache-2.0.txt.
Comlink is used unmodified, as bundled into aioli.js by the Aioli project
(the bundler removed the comment above from the file).

The programs
============
Program (folder)              Licence
bcftools/1.10                 MIT/Expat; with HTSlib 1.10 (MIT/Expat, modified 3-clause BSD)
coreutils/8.32                GNU GPL version 3 or later
diffutils/3.10 (diff, cmp)    GNU GPL version 3 or later – not a Biowasm build
gawk/5.1.0                    GNU GPL version 3 or later
grep/3.7                      GNU GPL version 3 or later
grep/3.11 (for "grep -P")     GNU GPL version 3 or later; with PCRE2 10.42 (3-clause BSD with the
                              PCRE2 exemption) – not a Biowasm build
htslib/1.17 (bgzip, tabix)    MIT/Expat, modified 3-clause BSD
minimap2/2.22                 MIT
samtools/1.17                 MIT/Expat
sed/4.8                       GNU GPL version 3 or later

The source code and build recipes of the GPL programs are in ../licenses/
(see ../licenses/README.txt). Each .wasm file also contains parts of the
Emscripten runtime and its C/C++ libraries (musl, libc++, compiler-rt; MIT,
Apache 2.0 with LLVM exception), and the programs that read compressed files
contain zlib; htslib-based programs also bzip2 and liblzma. The licence texts
of these libraries are in ../licenses/runtime-libraries/.
